needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing the road.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers at night.
